note: The browser rows are measured on the nightly runner (ubuntu-24.04-arm, headless Chromium, seed 7, 60 s a row), from the audio-quality-run artifacts of the seven scheduled Nightly runs on main from 2026-10-29 to 2026-11-04 (40885347517, 41065371094, 41204380716, 41313466339, 41483654426, 41656613559, 41852517544), the first after a fresh subscriber stopped receiving the relay's cached history. The AAC rows predate the TS importer publishing each PES as one group. Each ceiling is the worst of its seven nights times 1.25, plus one runner hiccup, rounded up to two significant figures. The hiccup is sized from the single gaps the 2026-10-08 night put on otherwise clean rows, the fixed-250 control among them: 250 underruns/min, 700 gap ms/min, 3.3 skips/min, 280 discarded ms/min, 0.01 stalled, 0.015 silence, and one 20 ms bucket of target. Budgeted this way, every night passes when it is held out of its row's measurement except one, and that row's own ceiling includes it: the 2026-11-03 Opus bursty row raised its target to 300 ms 2.6 s in and held it for one 20 s half-life before settling at 180. Such startup holds, Opus near-zero's 100 ms on 2026-10-30 and 10-31 among them, are budgeted as measured. These ceilings record today's player as the runner hears it, not target audio quality. To re-measure, download the same artifact from the latest scheduled nightlies (`gh run download <id> -n audio-quality-run`), which keep every run, and apply the same rule. The replay rows are deterministic, so their ceilings are exactly what they measured, through the end of each recording, with no headroom: any regression fails them, and an improvement should be tightened in. They were last re-measured on 2026-10-22 using version 3 traces with encoded frame durations: AAC-LC uses its fixed 1024 samples, and relay-mic retains Opus packet TOC durations. relay-mic was re-recorded on 2026-11-03 from a real microphone, Chrome 156 on a MacBook Air publishing its built-in microphone through the public relay, recorded by headless Chromium on a Linux host (35 s, minimum RTT 2 ms), which raised its target ceiling from 60 to 80 ms and its silence from 0 to 0.001 as measured. The recording path itself has no added RTT. relay-mic-rtt40 is the 2026-11-03 Chrome row at 40 ms of added RTT on that laptop (180 s, minimum RTT 47 ms), kept as the baseline time stretch must bring to zero. player_underruns_per_min, the player's own counter that its stats panel shows, is budgeted on the replay rows only, exactly as measured on 2026-11-03; it counts the run-dry re-stalls the tap files as stalled time. The local-aac replay's stalled ceiling rises from 0.008 to 0.017 and silence from 0.015 to 0.020 because replay no longer stretches each frame to nearby timestamp gaps; the production player is unchanged. All other changed replay ceilings tighten to the exact measurement. That replay calibration leaves browser and native ceilings unchanged. bursty-aac is the 2026-10-18 AAC bursty isolated capture, recorded with the observer subscribed at the decoder's 2 s budget, so it holds every group the player saw. The native rows are provisional: measured on a loaded developer host (x86_64 Linux, the private PulseAudio null sink, seed 7, 60 s a row) on 2026-10-17, three runs of every row from the debug build nightly uses plus three more of the AAC rows from a release build, which played alike. Each ceiling is the worst clean run times 1.25, plus one native hiccup sized from the unimpaired Opus row's worst run (20 underruns/min, 50 gap ms/min, 2.2 skips/min, 110 discarded ms/min, 0.01 stalled, 0.005 silence, one 20 ms bucket of target), rounded up to two significant figures. On that host the null sink's clock ran about 150 ppm slow against the monotonic clock, read within 5 ms at p95 per sample, and its output latency sat between 14 and 28 ms. Five of the 36 AAC rows (none of the 18 Opus rows) voided on the clock: the device stopped pulling for about two seconds mid-row, sometimes after a backend error and a stream restart, which is a native playback defect rather than noise, and the ceilings exclude those runs. Re-measure from the nightly runner's artifacts once it has a week of native rows.
